review.brief_reason: The change is exact factoring: x0*x1 is pulled out of the first four terms and -x2 out of the three x2-linear terms; all other terms are byte-identical. The only structural edit is dropping Abs around sin(pi*sin(pi*Min(0.42753242915424394, sqrt(Abs(x2))))). With m=Min(c,sqrt(Abs(x2))) in [0,c], pi*m in [0,~1.34313] subset [0,pi/2], so s=sin(pi*m) in [0,~0.97420]<1 and pi*s in [0,~3.06053] subset [0,pi]; hence that outer sin is >=0 for every real x2 (equal to 0 only at x2=0). Thus Abs is redundant: values are unchanged everywhere and sqrt stays defined on all of R^4, so domain is preserved. No counterexample exists; the factored form uses strictly fewer multiplications.
